name: Shanghai Top Numerical Control Technology Co., Ltd. Class H
summary: Shanghai Top Numerical Control Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2007 and headquartered in Shanghai, researches, develops, produces and sells intelligent manufacturing equipment, mainly for aviation and aerospace. Its range includes CNC process equipment and many types of five-axis machine tools, such as mirror milling, drilling and riveting, and friction stir welding machines, plus repair and maintenance services. Customers also come from automotive, new energy, medical device, shipbuilding and mold-making industries.
